units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 1:6">Targ. Ez. I, 6</cite>; a. e.; v. <cite ref="A02266"><he>אַנְפָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:3">Gen. R. s. 35</cite>, beg. <he>למיחזי סבר אַפָּאִי</he> to see my countenance.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:10">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> it is right <he>הדין אַפָּהּ כסי</he> that the face of this (idol) is covered.—
M. Kat. 20ᵇ באַפָּהּ in her presence, בלא א׳ in her absence.—Transf. front.
Ḥull. 47ᵃ אפה וכ׳ the front (of the lungs) facing the examiner.—With ל-, towards, opposite.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 72a:4">Snh. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>קאי לאפאי</he> he places himself opposite me (for defence).
Pes. 111ᵇ לאפֵּיה דשמאליה (Ms. M. להדיה ש׳) towards, by his left side.—Pl. אַפִּין, אַפַּיָּא, face (b. h. אפים, פנים).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 1:6">Targ. Ez. I, 6</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>א׳ בא׳</he> face to face.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:2">Cant. R. to III, 11</cite> the angel has <he>חמש א׳</he> five faces.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:5">Lam. R. to V, 5</cite> <he>א׳ בשחור</he> in darkness of countenance, in sadness.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 4:2:3">Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᶜ</cite> bot <he>ולא אמרין לה לכל א׳</he> but one must not say so in the presence of all (publicly).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:11">Targ. Cant. I, 11</cite>.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:5">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>אַפֵּי הלבתא</he> methods of talmudical disquisitions.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:25">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>שיתין א׳</he> sixty ways of interpretation.
Ber. 4ᵇ בתמניא א׳ (Var. אלפין, Ms. M. אלף בית) in eight ways, eightfold acrosticon.—באפי נפשיה for itself, separately.
